name: Chin Tuck
description: Gently retract the chin straight back as if making a double chin, keeping eyes level. Hold to reduce forward head posture and upper cervical strain.

name: Upper Trapezius Stretch
description: Gently bring your ear toward one shoulder until a mild stretch is felt along the side of the neck; keep the opposite shoulder relaxed.

name: Neck Rotation
description: Slowly turn your head to look over each shoulder within a comfortable range—no forcing. Improves cervical rotation.

name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
description: Bring one arm across the chest and use the other arm to gently press until you feel a stretch in the rear shoulder.

name: Doorway Pec Stretch
description: Forearms on a doorframe with elbows at 90°, step through until a stretch is felt across the chest and front of shoulders.

name: Sleeper Stretch
description: Lie on your side with the bottom arm bent; gently rotate the forearm toward the floor to stretch the posterior shoulder capsule.

name: Double-Arm Doorway Stretch
description: Both arms on the doorframe at shoulder height; step forward to open the chest and stretch the pectorals.

name: Wall Corner Stretch
description: Place forearms on two meeting walls and lean in to stretch pecs and anterior shoulders.

name: Supine Chest Opener
description: Lie with arms out to the sides or on a rolled towel along the spine to passively extend the thoracic spine and open the chest.

name: Thread the Needle
description: From hands and knees, reach one arm under the body and rotate to stretch the mid-upper back.

name: Cat-Cow
description: Alternate between spinal flexion and extension on hands and knees to mobilize the thoracic spine.

name: Open Book Stretch
description: Side-lying with knees bent; rotate the top arm open like a book to improve thoracic rotation.

name: Child's Pose
description: Sit back on heels with arms reaching forward to gently lengthen and decompress the lumbar spine.

name: Knee-to-Chest
description: Supine: pull one knee toward the chest to stretch the lower back and hip flexor region.

name: Supine Spinal Twist
description: Lie on your back, drop knees to one side while shoulders stay down for gentle lumbar rotation.

name: Dead Bug (Isometric)
description: Supine with hips and knees at 90°, press lower back into the floor and hold to engage deep abdominals.

name: Bird Dog
description: From quadruped, extend opposite arm and leg while keeping the trunk stable—strengthens anti-extension control.

name: Pelvic Tilts
description: Supine: gently rock the pelvis to flatten and arch the low back slightly to mobilize the lumbar spine.

name: Wall Biceps Stretch
description: Arm extended behind you on a wall, turn body away until a stretch is felt in the front of the upper arm.

name: Seated Biceps Stretch
description: Sit and place hands behind you with fingers down; straighten elbows gently to stretch biceps.

name: Horizontal Bar Hang Stretch
description: Grip a bar at shoulder height and step forward to extend the elbows and stretch elbow flexors (use light intensity).

name: Overhead Triceps Stretch
description: Reach overhead, bend elbow, and use the other hand to gently add flexion until triceps stretch.

name: Cross-Body Triceps Reach
description: Reach one arm overhead and behind the head, lightly assist with the other hand.

name: Towel Triceps Stretch
description: Hold a towel behind the back—one hand overhead, one at low back—and walk hands together gently.

name: Wrist Extensor Stretch
description: Arm extended, palm down; flex the wrist with the other hand to stretch the top of the forearm.

name: Wrist Flexor Stretch
description: Arm extended, palm up; extend the wrist gently with the other hand for the underside of the forearm.

name: Prayer Stretch
description: Palms together in front of chest; lower hands toward the waist to stretch forearms and wrists.

name: Pigeon Pose
description: From a lunge, place the front shin across and sink the hips for a deep hip external rotator stretch.

name: Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
description: Half-kneeling: tuck pelvis slightly and shift forward to stretch the hip flexors of the rear leg.

name: Butterfly Stretch
description: Seated with soles together; gently press knees toward the floor for adductor and hip opening.

name: Figure-Four Stretch
description: Supine: cross one ankle over the opposite knee and pull the thigh toward you to stretch the glute.

name: Supine Glute Hug
description: Pull one knee toward the same-side shoulder for a targeted glute and piriformis stretch.

name: Seated Figure-Four
description: Seated: cross ankle over knee and hinge forward with a flat back to stretch the glute.

name: Standing Quad Stretch
description: Stand and pull the heel toward the glute, knees together, to stretch the quadriceps.

name: Side-Lying Quad Stretch
description: Lie on your side, bend the top knee and pull the heel toward the glute.

name: Prone Quad Stretch
description: Lie face down, bend one knee and gently assist with a strap or hand to stretch the front of the thigh.

name: Standing Forward Fold
description: Hinge at hips with soft knees as needed; reach toward the floor for posterior chain length.

name: Seated Hamstring Stretch
description: Sit with one leg extended; hinge forward from the hip toward the toes.

name: Supine Hamstring Stretch
description: Lie on your back, use a strap or hands behind thigh to straighten the knee and lift the leg.

name: Heel Slides
description: Supine: slide heel toward buttocks and back to improve knee flexion range without forcing.

name: Terminal Knee Extension
description: Seated with knee bent over edge of chair; straighten fully and hold 1–2 seconds for quad activation.

name: Short-Arc Quad Set
description: Small pillow under knee; press knee down to straighten the leg isometrically to support patellar tracking.

name: Wall Calf Stretch
description: Hands on wall, back leg straight, heel down—stretch the gastrocnemius.

name: Stair Calf Drop
description: Stand on step edge; let heels drop below level for soleus and Achilles length.

name: Soleus Stretch
description: Wall stretch with back knee bent to target the deeper soleus muscle.
